stories.title: From laser shields to iPhone detectors: inside China’s booming secrecy industry

en.title: From laser shields to iPhone detectors: inside China's booming secrecy industry
en.summary: China's Ministry of State Security has warned government departments about surveillance threats including laser-based eavesdropping on classified meetings. The warning highlights a growing industry focused on protecting against espionage and unauthorized information gathering.

stories.title: Don’t leave Asia’s ageing debate until it’s too late

en.title: Don't leave Asia's ageing debate until it's too late
en.summary: Japan's population aged 65 and over has reached a record 29.6 percent, with 9.43 million older workers comprising 13.8 percent of the employed workforce. Many Asian businesses rely on older workers who have not fully retired.

stories.title: Canada’s PM Carney makes case for Canadian unity as Alberta referendum nears

en.title: Canada's PM Carney makes case for Canadian unity as Alberta referendum nears
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney urged Alberta to reject an upcoming referendum on separating from Canada, cautioning that such a vote would trigger a prolonged and uncertain process during a challenging period for the country.

stories.title: Catholics in US Army must not take part in firing squad, armed forces archbishop says

en.title: Catholics in US Army must not take part in firing squad, armed forces archbishop says
en.summary: A senior US archbishop has called on Catholic military members to refrain from participating in the planned firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan, raising objections to the Pentagon's unprecedented plan to broadcast the execution.

stories.title: Hellboy actress Selma Blair arrested for allegedly injuring 2 flight attendants

en.title: Hellboy actress Selma Blair arrested for allegedly injuring 2 flight attendants
en.summary: Actress Selma Blair was arrested after a Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles to New York landed at JFK Airport for allegedly being physically abusive toward two flight attendants.

stories.title: Ukraine’s EU accession bid advances after Kyiv passes minority rights law

en.title: Ukraine's EU accession bid advances after Kyiv passes minority rights law
en.summary: Ukraine's path toward EU membership progressed as lawmakers passed legislation protecting national minorities, clearing a major obstacle that Hungary had previously used to block the membership application.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham says Iran’s IRGC ‘highly likely’ to have been behind RAF Fairford incident

en.title: UK PM Burnham says Iran's IRGC 'highly likely' to have been behind RAF Fairford incident
en.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps likely coordinated a suspected plot targeting the RAF Fairford airbase, which prompted security operations and arrests.

stories.title: Elon Musk becomes biggest known donor in midterm elections in bid to save Republicans

en.title: Elon Musk becomes biggest known donor in midterm elections in bid to save Republicans
en.summary: Elon Musk emerged as the largest known donor in midterm elections, contributing over $276 million since July to support Republican candidates and maintain GOP congressional majorities.

stories.title: Hong Kong can boost regional prosperity through ‘soft connectivity’, adviser says

en.title: Hong Kong can boost regional prosperity through 'soft connectivity', adviser says
en.summary: A senior policy adviser to Hong Kong's leader stated that the city's institutional strengths and connections with mainland China and the world position it as a regional hub where trade can leverage its unique advantages.

stories.title: US federal agents search Democrat Ilhan Omar’s home as part of a criminal investigation

en.title: US federal agents search Democrat Ilhan Omar's home as part of a criminal investigation
en.summary: Federal agents conducted a search of Democratic congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home in Minnesota during an active criminal investigation, occurring shortly before her re-election campaign.

stories.title: Hong Kong to expand indices, derivatives and yuan-denominated products: HKEX CEO

en.title: Hong Kong to expand indices, derivatives and yuan-denominated products: HKEX CEO
en.summary: HKEX plans to introduce new measures including yuan-denominated gold futures and stock trading to increase market liquidity, attract international investors, and promote greater use of China's currency as Hong Kong reinforces its role as a global financial centre.

stories.title: Few Hong Kong investors take interest in listing by Africa’s top phone maker Transsion

en.title: Few Hong Kong investors take interest in listing by Africa's top phone maker Transsion
en.summary: Transsion Holdings' HK$3.36 billion Hong Kong IPO attracted modest interest with roughly 3.5 times oversubscription and about 14,000 applications during bookbuilding. The lukewarm response raises concerns about market sentiment for fourth-quarter new listings.

stories.title: Former HSBC executive launches wealth platform powered by team of AI agents

en.title: Former HSBC executive launches wealth platform powered by team of AI agents
en.summary: Trista Sun, a former HSBC managing director, has launched Equora, an AI-driven wealth management start-up targeting a billion-dollar valuation. The platform aims to help investors manage finances proactively through artificial intelligence agents.

stories.title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs

en.title: China bets on molten salt and CO2 to help meet its power needs
en.summary: China is constructing the world's first utility-scale power plant combining supercritical CO2 generation and molten salt energy storage in Yantai. The Ruitan project aims to reduce energy wastage and improve electrical grid stability.

stories.title: Brake-pedal failures in luxury EV put Chinese cars’ quality in regulatory spotlight

en.title: Brake-pedal failures in luxury EV put Chinese cars' quality in regulatory spotlight
en.summary: Safety testing revealed brake-pedal failures in a Huawei-backed luxury EV, raising quality concerns. Chinese regulators have published draft rules to strengthen testing and oversight of new car models.
